policy.excerpt_convention: Each repaired case record's excerpt is one or more CONTIGUOUS verbatim runs of the opinion, joined by ' ... ' when the runs are non-adjacent in the opinion -- the convention the registry already used for CIT-REAL-3 and CIT-REAL-15 after the B8b repair, both of which passed attestation round 1. No ellipsis is inserted INSIDE a run, and every proposition's authoritative_excerpt is a single uninterrupted run substring. No editorial headnote, digest, or 'Held:'/'As fetched:' synopsis text survives in any of the seven records.
policy.aggregator_disclosure: All seven opinions are pre-archive decisions with NO official courts.ca.gov hosting (already documented since the B8a officiality audit). A full-text aggregator reproduction is the only route to VERBATIM judicial language for them; the aggregator caveat remains in publication_or_precedential_status / discovery_notes and is surfaced in the reviewer bundle caveat block for every dependent task.
policy.artifacts_preserved: Reporter star-pagination markers (e.g. *1015, *482) and footnote markers (e.g. [1]) that fall inside a verbatim run are preserved rather than silently deleted, so a verifier's verbatim comparison against the source succeeds character for character.
policy.status_entailment: Every publication/precedential/citable criterion is now grounded on (a) a California Official Reports volume-index entry -- publication in the Official Reports IS what the index entry records -- plus (b) Cal. Rules of Court, rule 8.1115(d) ('A published California opinion may be cited or relied on as soon as it is certified for publication or ordered published'), an official Judicial Council source already in the registry. The bare word 'precedential', which no packet excerpt states, was replaced everywhere by the entailed 'published in the California Official Reports at <cite> and ... may be cited or relied on'.

review_bundle_byte_identity.method: sha256 of every review-bundles/tasks/<id>.md before and after, plus a line-level diff
review_bundle_byte_identity.finding: The builder stamps no timestamp and no randomness. The only delta in an unmodified packet is the '| dataset_hash | <64 hex> |' row, which is benchmarkDatasetHash() over the WHOLE dataset -- the deliberate binding that makes an attestation stop counting when any task changes. It is content-derived, not volatile, so it cannot be pinned by changing the invocation and must change when the dataset changes. bundles.jsonl rows for unmodified tasks differ only in the dataset_hash field; index.md differs only in the header hash and the 19 touched rows; manifest.json differs only in generated_from_dataset_hash; README.md is byte-identical.
